caption: One tenant key-encryption key wraps the thousand data keys, and each data key encrypts one object; the root key that wraps the tenant key never leaves the HSM. Rotating the tenant key rewraps the data keys and leaves the stored ciphertext untouched.

spec.title: Key hierarchy
spec.aria: A key hierarchy from a root key in an HSM, to a tenant key-encryption key that wraps 1,000 data encryption keys, to 1,000 encrypted objects.
